description: Arrange three related web files (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) in split-editor layout and synchronize changes across them. The workspace contains a contact form with inconsistent naming. Your task: (1) Open form.html, styles.css, and script.js, (2) Arrange them in split-editor view using 'Split Editor Right' or 'Split Editor Down' commands so multiple files are visible simultaneously, (3) In form.html: change class='old-form' to class='contact-form' and id='oldSubmit' to id='submitBtn', (4) In styles.css: add .contact-form selector with form styling, add #submitBtn selector with button styling (background-color, padding, border-radius), and add #submitBtn:hover selector with hover color change, (5) In script.js: update the getElementById or querySelector to target 'submitBtn' instead of 'oldSubmit'. All identifier changes must be consistent across files. Save all files when complete.
